title: IBM Spins Off the First Pure-Play Quantum Chip Foundry
summary: IBM has spun off the first pure-play quantum chip foundry as part of a $2 billion CHIPS Act investment, focusing on 300mm superconducting silicon wafer fabrication for quantum computing hardware. This move represents a significant shift toward dedicated quantum chip manufacturing infrastructure separate from traditional semiconductor production.
problem_solved: Addresses the lack of dedicated manufacturing infrastructure for quantum computing chips, which require specialized processes different from traditional silicon fabrication.
why_valuable: Creates specialized quantum chip production capability essential for scaling quantum computing from laboratory research to commercial viability.
